name: basic_sync_branch
assertions: fetches latest refs from the remote
rebases the current branch onto the upstream
pushes the rebased branch to the remote
reports the full sync result (fetch, rebase, push)

name: fetch_rebase_and_push
assertions: recognizes the three-step workflow as a sync intent
performs fetch, rebase, and push in sequence
uses force-with-lease for safe push after rebase
does NOT create merge commits

name: custom_remote_branch_args
assertions: uses 'upstream' as the remote
targets 'develop' as the branch to sync against
fetches from upstream, rebases onto upstream/develop
pushes to the correct remote after rebase

name: push_confirmation_check
assertions: completes fetch and rebase steps first
confirms with the user before pushing (if force-push required)
uses --force-with-lease instead of --force
reports push success with remote ref and commit range

name: negative_just_rebase
input: just rebase my branch, don't push
assertions: does NOT trigger the sync skill
recognizes the explicit no-push intent
routes to the /fr skill for fetch-and-rebase only

name: negative_fast_forward
assertions: does NOT trigger the sync skill
recognizes fast-forward as a different operation (/ff)
does NOT perform a rebase or push

name: sync_with_conflicts
input: sync my feature branch to latest
assertions: fetches and begins the rebase
halts the sync pipeline if rebase conflicts occur
does NOT push if rebase was not completed cleanly
provides conflict resolution guidance before retrying

name: sync_up_to_date
assertions: fetches and detects no new upstream changes
skips unnecessary rebase when already up to date
pushes any local commits that are ahead of remote
reports current sync status clearly
